behaviours.observe_source: Phylactery 500933: Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of the Phylactery 50132 (2000 ms cast, DurationIndex 4, 120000 ms $d); Effect[1] (a school absorb) is removed by AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:303-304. necromancer_defense::OnDamage (AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:329-353): while the caster's Phylactery lives, a hit that would leave the caster below 10% health is cut to leave 1 health and casts Shade 500730 (8000 ms; Effect[2] aura 40 school immunity, all schools) and Shade Hidden 500729; while 500730 is up every damage is set to 0; OnSpellCheckCast refuses the caster's casts (SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE, AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp:158-159) and CanUnitAttack refuses its attacks (AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:355-361). The striker (Harvest Golem 36, passive, spell_hit_bonus 100) casts the strikes at the caster through the harness. The same strike at 20000 of 100000 health, which leaves the caster above 10%: no Shade in either phase.

behaviours.name: Necromancy (Life Force)
behaviours.quote: Allows you to summon Undead minions using Life Force.
behaviours.observe_source: Necromancy 804360 (Effect[0] dummied, AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:111) describes the minion system. Scale() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:279-332) runs at the summon and every 1000 ms (UpdateAI event 1): attack power = (caster Intellect + max(Frost, Shadow spell power)) x 0.4 x the minion's Life Force cost; the minion's 805015 Effect[1] magic damage done = (Intellect + spell power) x 0.2 x cost; resistances = the caster's x 0.4 (armor x 0.35); melee, ranged and spell hit chance copied; base spell crit = the caster's Frost spell crit; cast speed and swing interval follow the caster's cast speed. Scale() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:279-332) runs at the summon and every 1000 ms (UpdateAI event 1): attack power = (caster Intellect + max(Frost, Shadow spell power)) x 0.4 x the minion's Life Force cost; the minion's 805015 Effect[1] magic damage done = (Intellect + spell power) x 0.2 x cost; resistances = the caster's x 0.4 (armor x 0.35); melee, ranged and spell hit chance copied; base spell crit = the caster's Frost spell crit; cast speed and swing interval follow the caster's cast speed. The Ghoul's UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED follows the caster's (Scale(): x speed / inherited speed): 1 before, 1 / 1.2 = 0.83333 after Icy Veins 12472. The tooltip states no figure: the after reading is judged for the direction only (below the before reading, at most 0.999); the factors above are the code's and are not expectations, and the before reading is the control state.

behaviours.name: Champion of Kel'thuzad (Lich Form cooldown)
behaviours.quote: While your Lich Form is active, your Champion spells will now cooldown faster.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:194-196: each 5000 ms tick of 704676's own Effect[0] (aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude 5000) reduces Gravebound 805049, Spellbound 807811 and Icebound Champion 807813 by 5000 ms while Lich Form 500981 is on the caster: twice the normal rate. The tooltip states no figure; 150000 ms is that rate over Gravebound Champion's RecoveryTime 300000 ms. Lich Form (DurationIndex 21, permanent) is cast 1500 ms after the priming cast in every arm, so the control differs in 704676 alone. Arms: 160000 ms after the priming cast without 704676 (refused, SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67), with it (through: ready near 150000 ms), and 140000 ms after it with it (refused: the cut is no faster than 5 s per 5 s). cast_power 1373 (player_class_stats BaseMana) covers the 15% and 10% base-mana costs.

behaviours.name: Unholy Runes (Corpse Explosion reset)
behaviours.quote: and damage dealt by Blight now has a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of Corpse Explosion.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:130-131: an own Blight 500237 hit (periodic by id, :80-81) with Chance(player, 561353) ($h 5, ProcChance of 561353) removes Corpse Explosion 533236's cooldown (Reduce with INT32_MAX: RemoveSpellCooldown, AscensionNecromancer.cpp:214-220). Corpse Explosion (RecoveryTime 60000 ms) is primed, 300 Blight 500237 hits (cast directly, no global cooldown) land on the dummy 1500 ms later, and Corpse Explosion is attempted 500 ms after them: refused without 561353 (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67), through with it. At 5% per hit, no reset in 300 hits has probability 0.95^300 = 2.1e-7 per run; the chance itself is a data value (561353 ProcChance), the reset is the behaviour.

behaviours.name: Bone Ward
behaviours.quote: While active, Armor is increased by $s2%
behaviours.observe_source: 681529 Effect[1] aura 101 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT, MiscValue 1 (armor), BasePoints 49 DieSides 1 (50, $s2), TARGET_UNIT_CASTER: a TOTAL_PCT modifier of UNIT_MOD_ARMOR, so the armor read before the cast gains 50% of itself. The caster's armor is read before and after a real cast of 681529 (its aura removed first), at the reference armor and with Greater Armor 11348 (aura 22, +450 armor, a precondition fixture by harness set_aura) set, so the gain follows the armor; the reading before each cast is the no-ward control (ADR 0213).

behaviours.name: Bone Ward
behaviours.quote: and Stamina by $s3%
behaviours.observe_source: 681529 Effect[2] (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS rewritten to SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA on the caster, AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:209-210) aura 137 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, MiscValue 2 (Stamina), BasePoints 9 DieSides 1 (10, $s3). behaviours.name: Bone Ward (minions)
behaviours.quote: Activate a Bone Ward on yourself and your Undead minions
behaviours.observe_source: aura_ascension_necromancer_lifecycle (AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:109-121): when 681529 applies to the caster it adds a copy (WardMinionEffectMask, AscensionNecromancer.h:98-107) to every minion; a minion raised while the ward is up gets the copy at its summon (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:532-538). The Ghouls 50073 carrying 681529 from the caster are counted: one Ghoul raised without the ward reads 0 (the control); then Bone Ward is cast (the first Ghoul still up) and a second Ghoul raised, so both carry it: 2 (Life Force capacity 2, a Ghoul occupies 1, AscensionNecromancer.cpp:93-104).

behaviours.name: Bone Ward (attack power)
behaviours.quote: reduces the target's attack power by ${-($704706m1+$704706ppl1)}
behaviours.observe_source: Bone Toss 707669 (the spell AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:87-92 casts from the caster at the attacker of a ward holder) Effect[0] 64 triggers 704706: Effect[0] aura 344 rewritten to SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER (AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:127-128), BasePoints -24 DieSides 1, RealPointsPerLevel -4 from SpellLevel 10: at caster level 60, -24 - 4 x 50 + 1 = -223 (${-($704706m1+$704706ppl1)} = 223). The dummy (Harvest Golem 36 at level 60) carries AP Test 56412 (aura 99, +801 attack power, a precondition fixture by harness set_aura in both phases, so the reading starts above 223 and the metric's floor of 0 cannot hide the reduction; without it the dummy read 38 / 42 and 0 in pair 20261112-235807 / -235926). The caster carries beeg spellpen 823764 (aura 123, -9999 target resistance on the magic schools, a precondition fixture) so the dummy's level-based magic resistance cannot resist the binary Bone Toss (one run of the first final set read 839 and 839, 20261113-004414). Its attack power is read with no cast and after one real 707669 cast by the caster at it: the gain must be -223 (expected_gain, ADR 0380). The trigger from damage taken is proven by the 681529 trigger_count entries.

behaviours.name: Ghoulify (damage breaks)
behaviours.quote: Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
behaviours.observe_source: Ghoulify 800706: Effect[0] aura 7 SPELL_AURA_MOD_FEAR (Mechanic 5), Effect[1] aura 56 SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM MiscValue 570 (Brain Eater, display 569), DurationIndex 64 (40000 ms, $d), TargetCreatureType 64 (Humanoid), 1500 ms cast (CastingTimeIndex 16). necromancer OnCalcMaxDuration (AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp:223-237): x1.25 with Putrifier 302923, and on a player at most 8000 ms, 9000 ms with 302923. Ghoulify ProcFlags 1704616 (damage taken), ProcChance 100, AuraInterruptFlags 0x480000. The fear is a breakable crowd control (AuraEffect::CalculateAmount, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:548-562: a damage budget of the level-60 warrior base health / 4.75, read 1048 on the target; HandleBreakableCCAuraProc, :7235-7243, removes the aura once the damage taken reaches it). A Kobold Vermin 6 target, the caster with QA Test 10000% Increased Frost Damage 13055 (aura 79, +9999% Frost, a precondition fixture by harness set_aura in both phases): Ghoulify alone leaves the fear on it (1, control); Ghoulify then a Lichfrost 801722 hit (about 22 x 101, above the budget) removes it (0).

behaviours.name: Ghoulify (damage below the budget)

behaviours.observe_source: Ghoulify 800706's fear is a breakable crowd control with a damage budget (AuraEffect::CalculateAmount, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:548-562; HandleBreakableCCAuraProc, :7235-7243): its aura amount read 1048 before and 1026 after one 22-damage Lichfrost 801722 hit (diagnostic 20261113-003440). Without a damage fixture the hit stays below the budget and the fear holds (1 before and after): with the damage_breaks entry, damage interrupts the effect only once it is large enough ("may").

Spell::Delayed (Spell.cpp:8056-8090, stock) pushes a cast back 500 ms per damage taken, reduced by SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK: 802988 Effect[0] aura 149 +50 ($s1) gives 250 ms. 802988 known throughout; one real Lichfrost at the dummy, a stationary striker hits the caster with Light of the Naaru 41394 (Holy, 1100) 1000 ms into the cast. behaviours.name: Lich Essence (pushback halved)

behaviours.observe_source: Lichfrost 501978 (2125 ms with 802988's -15% cast time), pushed back by one Light of the Naaru 41394 hit 1000 ms into the cast; Spell::Delayed (Spell.cpp:8075-8082, stock): 500 ms, x (1 - 50%) with 802988 Effect[0] aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK +50 ($s1) = 250 ms, so the cast completes near 2375 ms; an unreduced 500 ms pushback would end it near 2625 ms.
